free_tier.stated: 1 GB KVM VPS from the vendor's own plan table: 1 CPU core, 1 GB RAM, 55 GB SSD, 3 TB outbound with inbound stated as unmetered, 10 Gbps port, 1 IPv4 plus a /64 IPv6. USD 3.00 per month; the page advertises term discounts of 15 percent for 1 year, 20 percent for 2 years and 25 percent for 3 years, and a coupon SAVETEN for 10 percent off the first billing cycle. Locations listed: Miami, Los Angeles and New Jersey (US), Frankfurt (DE), London (UK). The tracker lists the same plan at USD 3.00 with 3,072 GB a month on a 10 Gbps port.
